_comment: The named constants of micropolisJS, lifted out of the code they were
written in. Every value here was read from the vendored source at commit
f13a1624d111d235e804bd80f48ba7c9f66a8e0f and matches it exactly. The file
location each one came from is recorded beside it.
A default that disagrees with the engine would break the whole argument of
this sandbox, which is an argument about what the defaults are. If you
change one, change it here and nowhere else.
schema.json exposes a subset of these as sliders. The rest are edited by
replacing this file, which is submitted as an asset.

crime._asserts: Crime is poverty plus density minus policing, and it is self-reinforcing: high crime lowers land value (see land_value.crime_penalty), and low land value raises crime.

land_value._asserts: Land value is a bid-rent gradient falling linearly from the city center. One line, and no other geometry is expressible.

pollution._asserts: Which land uses are dirty, and by how much. Residential and commercial pollute nothing at all.

traffic._asserts: A zone has access to jobs if a random walk of at most this many steps finds a destination. There is no routing and no shortest path.

smoothing._asserts: Influence spreads by repeated blurring. How far a police station reaches is a convolution count, not a distance anyone measured.

demography._asserts: The entire demographic and economic response of the city.
